system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. original_prompt: Generate a CloudFormation template creating a CloudWatch Dashboard summarizing the health of a Lambda-based API: invocations, errors, throttles, and average duration.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Generate a CloudFormation template creating a CloudWatch Dashboard summarizing the health of a Lambda-based API: invocations, errors, throttles, and average duration.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudWatch Dashboard for Lambda-based API health
Resources:
  LambdaFunction:
    Type: 'AWS::Lambda::Function'
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'lambda-api-${AWS::Region}'
      Runtime: nodejs14.x
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt 'LambdaExecutionRole.Arn'
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          exports.handler = async (event) => {
            return { statusCode: 200 };
          };
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: 'AWS::IAM::Role'
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: execution-role-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/${LambdaFunction}'
  CloudWatchDashboard:
    Type: 'AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard'
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Sub 'lambda-api-dashboard-${AWS::Region}'
      DashboardBody: |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "metrics": [
                  [
                    "AWS/Lambda",
                    "Invocations",
                    "FunctionName",
                    "${LambdaFunction}",
                    {
                      "stat": "Sum"
                    }
                  ]
                ],
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Invocations",
                "period": 300,
                "stat": "Sum"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "metrics": [
                  [
                    "AWS/Lambda",
                    "Errors",
                    "FunctionName",
                    "${LambdaFunction}",
                    {
                      "stat": "Sum"
                    }
                  ]
                ],
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Errors",
                "period": 300,
                "stat": "Sum"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 12,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "metrics": [
                  [
                    "AWS/Lambda",
                    "Throttles",
                    "FunctionName",
                    "${LambdaFunction}",
                    {
                      "stat": "Sum"
                    }
                  ]
                ],
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Throttles",
                "period": 300,
                "stat": "Sum"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 18,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "metrics": [
                  [
                    "AWS/Lambda",
                    "Duration",
                    "FunctionName",
                    "${LambdaFunction}",
                    {
                      "stat": "Average"
                    }
                  ]
                ],
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Average Duration",
                "period": 300,
                "stat": "Average"
              }
